title: Classic Descend Freestyle
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice swim
4x75 choice @1:30 (25 kick, 25 drill, 25 build)

Main Set:
5x100 Free @1:30 at 500 pace
500 Free @10:00 maintain same pace as 100s
4x100 Free @1:35 at 500 pace
400 Free @8:00 strong swim
3x100 Free @1:40 maintain 500 pace
300 Free best effort

Cool-down:
200 easy choice
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Workouts for Masters Swimmers
coach_notes: Pace workout. Swimmers hold their 500 race pace across broken swims, then descend the straight swims. Total distance ~3300 yards.

title: Ultra-Short Race-Pace Training (USRPT)
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice
3x200 choice @3:30 with fins (work on DPS, breathing patterns, dolphin kicks off walls)
4x50 Free build @1:00

Main Set:
20x50 Free @:20 rest (hold 200 race pace per 50; miss goal = sit out one repeat)
300 easy @2:00 rest
20x25 choice @:20 rest (alternate 2 stroke, 2 Free; hold 100 race pace per 25)

Cool-down:
300 choice
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Workouts for Masters Swimmers
coach_notes: USRPT method: swim at race pace with short rest, skip a rep if you miss the target. Teaches pace discipline. ~3300 yards.

title: IM Test Set
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice @:20 rest
400 IM @:20 rest (25 drill, 25 build)

Main Set:
6x150 IM @3:15 (50 of each stroke, IM rotation)
10x100 Free @2:00 (adjust for 15-20 sec rest)

Cool-down:
300 descend by 50s @:10 rest
6x50 choice descend @:10 rest
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Workouts for Masters Swimmers
coach_notes: Test set format. Use this mid-season to benchmark IM stroke splits and freestyle threshold pace. ~3000 yards.

title: Breathing Control Sprint Set
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice
100 kick
4x50 choice @:15 rest (IM order: 25 drill, 25 build)
8x25 choice @:10 rest (descend 1-4, 5-8)
50 easy @1:00 rest

Main Set:
2x25 Free @:45 sprint, no breaths
100 easy @2:00
4x25 Breast @:40 sprint, triple pullouts
100 easy @2:00
6x25 Back @:35 sprint, underwater kick to 20 yds
100 easy @2:00
8x25 Fly @:30 sprint, fewer than 3 breaths per 25
100 easy @2:00
6x25 Back @:35 sprint, underwater kick to 15 yds
100 easy @2:00
4x25 Breast @:40 sprint, triple pullouts
100 easy @2:00
2x25 Free @:45 sprint, no breaths

Cool-down:
300 easy choice
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Workouts for Masters Swimmers
coach_notes: Pyramid breathing pattern sprint set. Builds breath control across all four strokes. ~2550 yards.

title: Recovery Day Mixed Stroke
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice
4x100 choice @:15 rest (50 kick, 50 drill)
100 Reverse IM @:30 rest

Main Set (4 rounds):
2x25 kick @:40
2x50 drill @1:00
2x100 choice @2:30
2:00 rest
500 (25 Free/25 stroke, 50 Free/50 stroke, 75 Free/75 stroke, 100 Free/100 stroke) @:30 rest

Cool-down:
300 easy choice
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Workouts for Masters Swimmers
coach_notes: Recovery workout emphasizing technique and low intensity. Alternating stroke/Free pattern keeps it interesting. ~3100 yards.

title: 100 Race Pace Builder
text:
Warm-up:
400 Free
200 kick choice
4x50 drill/swim @1:00

Main Set:
5 rounds of:
  4x25 Free @1:00 (hold :15 or under per 25)
  50 easy + 1:00 extra rest between rounds

Cool-down:
6x50 easy back/free @1:10
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Coaching Speed Sets
coach_notes: Broken 100 race-pace set. Each round simulates a 100 race with extra rest. Teaches even splitting. ~2100 yards.

title: 500 Race Pace Repeats
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice
200 kick
4x75 IM @1:30

Main Set:
3 rounds of:
  5x100 Free @2:30 (hold 1:24 or under — 500 race pace)
  100 easy + 1:00 extra rest between rounds

Cool-down:
300 easy choice
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Coaching Speed Sets
coach_notes: Broken 500 race-pace set. Hold target pace across all 100s. If struggling, increase interval rather than lowering target. ~2800 yards.

title: Pyramid Distance Set
text:
Warm-up:
400 Free
4x100 IM @1:45

Main Set:
2 rounds of:
  1x400 Free @1:20/100 pace
  2x300 Free @1:20/100 pace
  3x200 Free @1:20/100 pace
  4x100 Free @1:20/100 pace

Cool-down:
400 easy pull
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Pool Long Distance Workouts
coach_notes: Classic pyramid structure for distance training. Maintain consistent pace as distances shorten. Increase pace each segment. ~6000 yards.

title: Descending Ladder with Sprints
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice
200 kick

Main Set:
100 easy + 500 negative split + 100 easy + 10x50 sprint @:45
100 easy + 400 negative split + 100 easy + 8x50 sprint @:45
100 easy + 300 negative split + 100 easy + 6x50 sprint @:45
100 easy + 200 negative split + 100 easy + 4x50 sprint @:45
100 easy + 100 sprint + 100 easy + 2x50 sprint @:45

Cool-down:
300 easy choice
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Pool Long Distance Workouts
coach_notes: Descending ladder combining endurance (negative splits) with sprint 50s. Great mid-season aerobic/anaerobic mix. ~4000 yards.

title: Set of 200s — Threshold Builder
text:
Warm-up:
5x200 Free @2:45 (this IS the warm-up)

Main Set:
5x200 Free @2:45 (moderate)
5x200 Free @2:40 (build effort)
5x200 Free @2:35 (strong)
5x200 Free @2:30 (fast)

Cool-down:
200 easy back
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Pool Long Distance Workouts
coach_notes: Pure volume threshold set. 25x200 total with descending intervals. No breaks between sets — mental and physical endurance. ~5200 yards.

title: All About Those Legs — Kick Focus
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice @:15 rest
100 kick choice @:15 rest
4x50 IM order @:15 rest (25 drill, 25 build)
8x25 choice @:10 rest (descend 1-4, 5-8)
50 easy @1:00 rest

Main Set:
2x200 kick @4:00 best stroke, sprint
100 easy @3:00
4x100 kick @2:00 worst stroke, sprint
100 easy @3:00
8x50 kick @1:00 IM order
100 easy @3:00
16x25 kick @:30 sprint choice

Cool-down:
300 easy choice
coach_notes: Dedicated kick workout progressing from long to short reps. Challenges both best and weakest kick strokes. ~3050 yards.

title: Stroke Work — 3-Round Progression
text:
Warm-up:
200 choice @3:30
200 kick @4:00
200 pull @3:30
200 choice @3:30

Main Set (3 rounds):
3x75 choice @1:30 (progression: 25 stroke/50 stroke/75 stroke/75 Free fast)
3x50 choice @1:00 (free/stroke alternating)
2x75 choice @1:30 (sprint)
1:00 rest between rounds

Cool-down:
6x50 choice @1:10 (drill-swim by 25)
coach_notes: Stroke development set. Each round increases stroke-specific swimming. Great for working non-free strokes. ~2900 yards.

title: Freestyle Focus — Descend by Round
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice @5:00
4x75 choice @1:30 (kick-swim-kick by 25)

Main Set (3 rounds):
200 Free @3:15 smooth
4x50 Free @1:00 (kick-swim by 25)
3x100 Free @1:30 descend 1-3

Cool-down:
6x50 choice @1:10
coach_notes: Freestyle-focused with descending 100s as the quality piece each round. Build speed across the three rounds. ~3000 yards.

title: Pull Set — Progressive 75s and 300s
text:
Warm-up:
200 choice @3:30
4x50 choice @1:15 (scull-swim by 25 or all scull)
200 choice @3:30

Main Set:
4x75 Free @1:30
300 pull @5:00
4x75 Free @1:25
300 pull @5:00
4x75 Free @1:20
300 pull @5:00
4x75 Free @1:15

Cool-down:
200 kick/swim
coach_notes: Pull focus with descending 75 intervals. Use paddles and buoy for 300s. Builds aerobic endurance and catch strength. ~2900 yards.

title: Fast Reps with Breath Control
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice @:15 rest
100 kick choice @:15 rest
4x50 IM order @:15 rest (25 drill, 25 build)
8x25 choice @:10 rest (descend 1-4, 5-8)
50 easy @1:00

Main Set:
4x50 Fly @1:00 fast, descend breaths (5,4,3,2 per 50)
4x25 Fly @:30 sprint, halfway underwater
200 easy @4:00
4x50 Back @1:00 fast, descend breaths
4x25 Back @:30 sprint, halfway underwater
200 easy @4:00
4x50 Breast @1:00 fast, descend breaths
4x25 Breast @:30 sprint, halfway underwater
200 easy @4:00
4x50 Free @1:00 fast, descend breaths
4x25 Free @:30 sprint, halfway underwater

Cool-down:
300 easy choice
coach_notes: All four strokes with breath control emphasis. Fast 50s + sprint 25s for each stroke. ~2950 yards.

title: Early Season Base Building
text:
Warm-up:
600 (200 swim, 200 kick, 200 pull)

Pre-set:
8x50 Free @1:00 (descend 1-4, 5-8)

Main Set:
3x300 Free @4:30 moderate
4x200 Free @3:00 build each 200
6x100 Free @1:30 descend 1-3, 4-6
8x50 Free @:50 fast

Cool-down:
400 (200 back, 100 breast, 100 easy free)
coach_notes: Classic early-season aerobic base set. Descending structure from long to short. Freestyle focus with progressive effort. ~4200 yards.

title: IM Order Endurance
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice
4x100 IM @1:45 (drill/swim by 25)

Main Set:
4x50 Fly @1:00
200 Free easy @3:30
4x50 Back @:55
200 Free easy @3:30
4x50 Breast @1:00
200 Free easy @3:30
4x50 Free @:50
200 Free easy @3:30
4x100 IM @1:45 descend 1-4

Cool-down:
300 easy choice (100 back, 100 breast, 100 free)
coach_notes: IM development set with stroke-specific 50s followed by free recovery. Finishes with descending IM 100s. ~3100 yards.

title: Technique and Speed Contrast Set
text:
Warm-up:
300 swim
200 kick
100 drill

Main Set:
8x25 drill choice @:40 (focus on one technical element)
4x50 swim @:50 (apply the drill focus at moderate pace)
8x25 sprint @:30 (maintain technique under speed)
200 easy
Repeat above block with a different stroke/drill focus

Cool-down:
4x100 easy @1:45 (50 back, 50 free)
coach_notes: Drill-swim-sprint contrast pattern. Swimmers pick a technical focus for each block. Teaches technique transfer to race speed. ~3000 yards.
